column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the DAST scan (AICHAT-28, docs/AICHAT-28/WORKLOG.md, US1).
# Passed to zap-baseline.py with -c. Columns, separated by TABs: rule id, action, rule name, reason.
#   FAIL    High risk. The scan exits 1 and the dast job fails.
#   WARN    Medium risk. Listed in the report and the job summary; the job passes (exit 2 is accepted).
#   IGNORE  Low and Informational risk, and false positives. Every IGNORE carries its reason in the last column.
# An IGNOREd rule is left out of ZAP's console summary and exit code; the full report still lists its alerts.
# To add a false positive: take the rule id from the report, add a line with IGNORE and the reason, and
# say in the pull request why the alert is not a real weakness. A rule that is not listed here is WARN.
# Use tabs, not spaces: zap-baseline.py rejects a line with fewer than three tab-separated columns.
